execution_disclosure.note: The 13 Agent Fabric stages were used as analytical lenses. No independent hosted agent instances were started, and no live provider/model deployment was verified.

measurement_readiness_baseline.meaning: Traceability baseline; not percentage complete or release readiness

findings.title: Measurement coverage gap
findings.observation: 97 catalog entries versus 61 measurement rows; the remaining 36 have no row in this subindex.
findings.required_action: Add evidence-backed rows or explicit dispositions for I-062..I-097; new entries start UNKNOWN/NOT_ASSESSED.

findings.title: Innovation operation review backlog
findings.observation: 177 records; 174 require review; 66 are UNKNOWN. Generator disables canonical promotion.
findings.required_action: Triage records by source, owner and family; do not edit generated outputs manually.

findings.title: Agent identity and workflow-stage ambiguity
findings.observation: Workflow-stage IDs AG-00..AG-12 differ from persistent role IDs AG-001..AG-013; no complete authoritative crosswalk was found.
findings.required_action: Keep identity and stage as separate typed entities and create an explicit versioned binding; no inferred merge/rename.

findings.title: Execution authority binding needs reconciliation
findings.observation: Workflow stages default to may_execute=false/may_promote=false while persistent registry contains runtime/operations roles with execution scope.
findings.required_action: Require a distinct VX execution principal, scoped expiring grant, policy decision, idempotency and audit record for side effects.

findings.title: Proof-before-promotion controls are a strong foundation
findings.observation: Operation-index promotion is disabled; workflow-stage agent definition rejects self-promotion.
findings.required_action: Preserve and verify these invariants at code, CI and runtime admission boundaries.

findings.title: Tests and automation exist but were not run in this review
findings.observation: Relevant tests and workflows are present, but this review did not execute repository CI.
findings.required_action: Capture passing receipts tied to the exact candidate commit.

findings.title: Live agent deployment is not established by role registration
findings.observation: Role definitions/code do not prove healthy live provider endpoints or deployed worker instances.
findings.required_action: Require provider/model/version, tools, policy, health, quota, timeout, revocation and runtime evidence.

review_lanes.review_lens: Interfaces, invariants, state and failure contracts
Trust boundaries, privilege and attack surface
Evidence freshness, digest and verifier independence

innovation_candidates.name: Evidence-Governed Agentic Engineering Loop
innovation_candidates.canonical_owner: VAIXLNS / NEXENT / XV / VX / VV responsibility boundary

priority_actions.action: Define a versioned agent-entity to workflow-stage crosswalk
priority_actions.acceptance: Each role/stage reference resolves uniquely; ambiguous mappings fail closed.

priority_actions.action: Reconcile agent execution authority and VX execution principal
priority_actions.acceptance: No external side effect or canonical write without a scoped expiring VX grant.

priority_actions.action: Extend measurement coverage for I-062 through I-097 or record explicit dispositions
priority_actions.acceptance: 97/97 entries have evidence-backed rows or explicit dispositions without synthetic scores.

priority_actions.action: Review all 174 operation-index records and triage 66 UNKNOWN states
priority_actions.acceptance: Every record has a source-bound disposition, reviewer and next action.

priority_actions.action: Capture commit-specific CI and proof receipts
priority_actions.acceptance: Relevant validation and tests pass on the exact candidate commit.

decision.reason: Reconcile current registries and evidence gaps before adding parallel canonical structures or enabling autonomous execution.
